decision_provenance: Illustrative accepted interpretation: integer means all i64 values under scalar-wrapping-v1; no actual user/solver approval is asserted.

requirements.text: The domain is all i64 inputs under the illustrative accepted machine profile.
requirements.source_excerpt: For an integer x, return x if x is nonnegative, and return zero otherwise.
assumptions: Interpretation of integer as i64 is an explicit illustrative decision.

requirements.text: Nonnegative inputs return the same integer.
